notes: Verified live on 2026-07-06 via raw curl (headers + HTML) of design.gamma.site and complete-consciousness-gyz0ycj.gamma.site, plus full browser hydration of two free-tier *.gamma.site pages. STRONGEST signal: HTTP header X-Super-Powered-By: gamma (present on both; works on Pro custom domains where the .gamma.site regex won't match). Sites are Next.js SSR apps (content is server-rendered ProseMirror/TipTap node-view markup, then React/Chakra-UI hydrated -> hybrid). No <meta name=generator>. JS/CSS from assets.gammahosted.com/<siteId>/_next/static/; images from cdn.gamma.app wrapped through imgproxy.gamma.app (resize/quality:80/resizing_type:fit/width:.../https://cdn.gamma.app/...); OG images on assets.api.gamma.app/<siteId>/screenshots/. External links rewritten to https://gamma.app/external-link?url=[...]. Served behind Cloudflare (Server: cloudflare, Nel/Report-To) but no CAPTCHA/challenge on a normal UA. BADGE DOWNGRADED: no 'Made with Gamma' badge was found on either fully-hydrated free-tier site; the only raw-HTML 'badge' token is the pdf-gamma-badge feature flag (a PDF/PPTX export watermark). The badge is optional (toggle 'Hide Made by Gamma' in Advanced Settings, removed on paid plans) and thus NOT a reliable web-site signature. Detect via: .gamma.site URL OR X-Super-Powered-By: gamma header OR assets.gammahosted.com asset host to also catch Pro custom-domain sites.
corrections: CONFIRMED (unchanged): detectUrlRegex \.gamma\.site (both refs are *.gamma.site); all 4 cdnDomains present in raw HTML (assets.gammahosted.com/_next/static, cdn.gamma.app/.../original|optimized, imgproxy.gamma.app/resize/... , assets.api.gamma.app/.../screenshots); metaGenerator empty (no generator tag); jsGlobals window.__NEXT_DATA__ (id=__next + __NEXT_DATA__ script); antiBot cloudflare (Server: cloudflare, no challenge); renderStrategy hybrid (SSR content + React hydration). All data-* attrs and gamma-moveable-wrapper, external-link?url= wrapping, published/[docId] route, favicon-192.svg, and the X-Super-Powered-By: gamma header were directly observed.
